name: Claude_Browser
instructions: Claude's built-in browser. preview_start opens a local dev server in a preview pane; navigate, computer and screenshot drive it.

tools.name: preview_start
tools.description: Start a preview of a local web app on a port and open it.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Navigate the browser to a URL.

tools.name: computer
tools.description: Click, type, scroll or press keys in the browser.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the browser.
